description: SQL-ACT-FAIL, deciding variants: failure class with the failing candidate in the middle, not first. With dbFailOnError: Fu (unique K; rows 1..3 and 100; UPDATE SET K = IIf(ID = 3, 100, K + 10) collides at ID 3), Fc (text S = '1','2','x','4'; UPDATE SET V = CLng(S) fails at ID 3), Fi (Req NOT NULL; INSERT SELECT with Null at the third source row) and Fp/Fch (relationship; DELETE FROM Fp WHERE ID <= 3 where only ID 3 has a child). Each statement's return, RecordsAffected, Errors and the rows afterwards. Follow-up probe (status F) for SQL-ACT-FAIL, SQL-CONTINUE; runs on a writable fresh copy of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
